Mod.Name: [Cronos Team] Archeology
Mod.Author: Cronos Team
Mod.Description:
► Unused features found in the game data and code, made usable again ◄
Every option is On by default.
◆ Archeology ◆ • RefineGFLevel: Restore the refine GF level check still in the game code (Dark Matter and Hero-trial need a level 100 GF). • WItem: Give Tonberry the unused W-Item battle command, allowing two items in one turn. • AutoNewGame: Switch on the developers' debug auto start: the title screen starts a New Game by itself after a few seconds without input. • OmegaLevel100: Omega Weapon is always level 100, like on PlayStation (1,161,000 HP). • SorceressSuccessionInfo: Unlock the never-reachable Information topic "Succession of Sorceress Power" at Edea's house (disc 3). • PSXOrgan: Restore the PlayStation organ of Ultimecia Castle: 8 notes instead of 4, and each note opens its own grate.
◆ Special thanks ◆ • myst6re for Deling tool and RE work • Maki for his work on RE

LatestVersion.ReleaseNotes: • 0.1 Split from FF8 Gameplay Customizer 0.8: RefineGFLevel, WItem, AutoNewGame, OmegaLevel100, SorceressSuccessionInfo and PSXOrgan.
